Required function exports for core ABI activation.
Serial runtime gate: one instance, one exclusive executor (WASM-N04).
Both Wasm **calls** and **memory** access for a given instance must share one
runtime so store/memory never race with `Function.invoke`. Implemented as a
dedicated serial queue (not a free-threaded lock + global queue hop).
Run exclusively on the serial executor (sync). Used by memory read/write/grow.
Re-entrant: if already on this queue, runs inline (avoids deadlock).
Run exclusively on the serial executor (async entry). Used by `call`.
Process-wide active instance counter (WASM-N10 `maxInstances`).
Production engines use ``shared``. Isolated instances may be constructed for tests.
Test-only reset (never called from production paths).
Capability-call meter shared by host import adapters (WASM-N10).
Record one capability call. Returns false if quota exceeded (fail closed).
Minimal WebAssembly binary encoder for core modules used as fixtures.
Minimal valid module exporting `codeeditor_abi_version` → 1 and empty stubs for required exports.
Memory export `memory` + import host functions.
Module exporting `codeeditor_abi_version` returning a fixed i32 plus required memory (E1 proof).
Guest uses data segment "OK" at offset 0 then host_send(0,2) — proves memory bridge (E4).
Cooperative infinite loop that polls `host_should_cancel` (legacy).
Pure noncooperative `loop { br 0 }` — no host calls in the loop body (WASM-N01).
Still imports should_cancel so the instrumenter can inject probes.
Module that attempts unbounded memory.grow (WASM-N02 / N16).
Module without exported memory (WASM-N03).
Module exporting memory.grow helper for host-side growth tests (WASM-N05).
Flood host_send (WASM-N10/N16).
Log flood (WASM-N11/N16).
Deep recursion / stack exhaustion (WASM-N16): poll calls itself until stack limit.
Huge table declaration that exceeds maxTableElements (WASM-N16).
Out-of-bounds memory load in poll (WASM-N16).
Capability-call flood via tight host_send loop (WASM-N10/N16).
Module with a loop but **no** host_should_cancel import — must fail closed at instrument (WASM-N01).
Instruments Wasm modules so pure noncooperative loops observe host cancellation (WASM-N01).
After every `loop` opcode, injects:
i64.const 0 ; i64.const 0 ; call <should_cancel> ; if ; unreachable ; end
so wall-time interrupt flags are observed without relying on guest cooperation.
Modules that cannot be instrumented safely are rejected fail-closed.
